# Highway 19 Media

> Highway 19 Media is a local marketing agency based in Spring Hill, Florida (Hernando County). It designs websites and landing pages, produces video, runs social media and paid advertising, and creates branding, graphic design, print and promotional products for small businesses in Spring Hill, Brooksville, Weeki Wachee, Hudson, New Port Richey and the US-19 corridor, and across the Tampa Bay area. Clients work with one local point of contact who manages as much or as little of their marketing as they need.

## Facts

- Name: Highway 19 Media (a Smart Man Media company)
- Based in: Spring Hill, Florida, USA. A home-based, service-area business: we come to the client, meet by video, or meet for coffee. There is no public storefront.
- Serves: Spring Hill, Brooksville, Weeki Wachee (Hernando County); Hudson, Port Richey, New Port Richey, Holiday (Pasco County); Tarpon Springs; Homosassa, Crystal River; the wider Tampa Bay area.
- Contact: highway19media@gmail.com, or the form at https://highway19media.com/contact/. Replies within 24 hours.
- Experience: more than 25 years across graphic design, websites, video production, print, advertising, 3D and motion graphics.
- Contracts: single projects, or ongoing 3-, 6- or 12-month engagements. No long-term contract is required.

## Services

- Website design: custom, template-based and AI-assisted websites on WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Magento and other platforms, with SEO and AEO foundations. Full websites generally start around $2,000; a Highway 19 Media landing page starts at $699. A landing page takes about a week; a full site a few weeks to a month.
- Video production: commercials, website hero videos, interviews, podcasts, testimonials, training and educational video, drone footage and ongoing social video, on location or in our Spring Hill studio (green screen, CGI and special effects). https://highway19media.com/video-production/
- Social media: content creation, post design, on-location social video and ongoing social media management.
- Paid advertising: Google Ads, Facebook & Instagram ads, and advertising inside AI assistants such as ChatGPT, built around audience, offer and existing data. We create the ad content (video, photography, design, copy) as well as running the campaigns. Ad spend is paid to the platforms and is separate from our fee.
- Branding and graphic design: logos, colours, typography, visual identity and production-ready vector files; individual design projects, hourly work or a retainer.
- Print and promotional products: business cards, flyers, catalogues, signs, vehicle graphics, shirts and branded merchandise, including fully custom products sourced directly from manufacturers.
